description: Kenmore Style Q HEPA Cloth Vacuum bags provide filtration for certified asthma and allergy-friendly vacuums and other select Kenmore and Kenmore Elite vacuums, such as Pet-Friendly or Progressive. Please be sure to check your manual and machine prior to ordering, to ensure proper fit. This package of Kenmore premium quality type 0 vacuum bags contains 6 replacement bags for select Kenmore vacuum cleaners. HEPA products are recommended for minimizing dust, pet dander and other common allergens in homes where people suffer from allergies and respiratory conditions. Studies show that most household allergens are 0. 3 microns or larger. Kenmore bagged vacuums with the enhanced HEPA certified filtration system capture 99. 97% of debris, up to 0. 3 microns and larger, trapping dander, dust particles, odors, pollen and bacteria inside the vacuum, reducing the number of allergy-induced pollutants in the room. Approved for certified asthma and allergy friendly canister and upright vacuums. HEPA standards are set by the U. S. Government's Department of Energy. This filter is Kenmore Approved. Kenmore Brand is the ONLY authorized and authentic seller of Kenmore vacuums, vacuum bags, filters, parts and accessories. Pack of 2.
